Introducing another beautiful addition to our Royal Garden Collection! A rich combination of olive green, deep burgundy, and crisp white gives this set a sophisticated, timeless look with just the right amount of artistic flair.

Our Royal Garden sets offer a fresh interpretation of the traditional Mah Jongg suits, blending beautiful colors and artistic details while keeping the classic characters players know and love.

Tegan Wolfepack is a designer living in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida. She loved collaborating with Mah Jongg Maven on this set, which allowed her to bring a fresh, playful perspective to a timeless game. description:

Tegan Wolfepack is a designer living in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida. She loved collaborating with Mah Jongg Maven on this set, which allowed her to bring a fresh, playful perspective to a timeless game. Outside the studio, she can usually be found adventuring outdoors with her husband and their goldendoodle, Ollie. Discover more of her work at www.wolfepack.design.

name: Mahj in Bloom – Engraved & Hand Painted American Mah Jongg Set
short_description: Artist inspired Mahj in Bloom American Mah Jongg set
description:
THE SETS ARE HERE! NOW IN STOCK!

We are so excited to finally share this beautiful artist collaboration with you!

Mah Jongg Maven is thrilled to partner with artist Lorra Kurtz, whose artistic interpretation of the game brings together fine art and tradition in a truly unique way.

Each tile draws inspiration from the themes, symbols, and visual language found throughout Lorra’s paintings. Together, we worked to create a set that maintains the integrity and recognizability of the traditional American Mah Jongg suits while bringing Lorra’s colorful artistic vision to the Bams, Craks, Dots, Flowers, Jokers, Dragons, and Winds.

And, of course, these tiles are engraved and hand painted — NOT printed! Beautifully crafted with an attention to detail that makes this a set to treasure and enjoy for years to come.

The set includes 10 Jokers and 12 Blanks, giving you the option to customize your Jokers with your own designs.

We think this collection is something truly special — where the beauty of fine art meets the tradition of the game we all love!

Please note: Product photos have been slightly softened to protect the exclusive artwork. The actual set is even more beautiful in person!

Visiter her website at: https://lorrakurtz.com

Bio and Inspiration for Lorra

name: Royal Garden Series – Artist Inspired 3 Layer Orange Red  American Mah Jongg Set
description:
We are thrilled to introduce our 3 Layer Royal Garden Artist-Inspired Collection. This exquisite Mah Jongg set offers a fresh interpretation of the traditional suits, blending timeless Mah Jongg heritage with a modern artistic vision.

Each tile is meticulously engraved and hand-painted, preserving the craftsmanship and quality that Mah Jongg Maven is known for. Designed to be treasured for years to come, these standard-sized tiles fit perfectly on 18-inch racks and in tile trays. They have a wonderful feel in your hands, feature larger numbers for easier visibility, and the beautifully designed suits are easily identifiable—eliminating the need for a key or guide.

The set includes everything needed to play American Mah Jongg, including all tiles, 8 Flowers, 10 Jokers, and 12 blank tiles.

To complete the experience, the Royal Garden Collection also features beautifully coordinated matching Mah Jongg mats, allowing players to create an elegant and cohesive table setting that brings the artistry of the collection from the tiles to the table.

We hope you fall in love with the beauty, craftsmanship, and exceptional playability of this extraordinary new collection from Mah Jongg Maven.

You can customize your Jokers.   Please know, once you customize them, we can not take a return on the set.  So,  if you want to be sure you love the set,  please make a note for us to hold onto the blanks for custom Jokers.

 

About our Artist:

Tegan Wolfepack is a designer living in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida. She loved collaborating with Mah Jongg Maven on this set, which allowed her to bring a fresh, playful perspective to a timeless game. Outside the studio, she can usually be found adventuring outdoors with her husband and their goldendoodle, Ollie. Discover more of her work at www.wolfepack.design.

name: Mah Jongg Tote with front pouch for Mat-comes with Matching Neoprene  Rack & Tile bag
description:
We are so excited to introduce our new fabulous Mah Jongg totes. The totes come in 3 colors with matching neoprene cases for your tiles and racks.    We hear people tell us  that it is so hard to carry the mats because they stick out of the bag.  So, we thought, why not make a tote like you see for Yoga bags, where you can secure  your mat on the front of bag to carry.  There are 2 zippers so you can set the size of your mat.    Here are a few more special things about these totes that make them the ideal way to carry and store your Mah Jongg set.

  1.   Padded tote to insure things stay protected (no matter how much you hard you are on it in the car or storing it
  2.   Zipper Neoprene bag to protect the tiles
  3. Zipper neoprene case for the racks to keep them protected. It will fit 20 inch racks.
  4.  The 2 zippers on either side of the Tote allow you to adjust how your mat holds on the tote
  5. 3 Fabulous colors with matching tile and rack case
  6. Your bag will say:  I am a Mah Jongg Maven ;).

Colors:

Light Pink Bag with Dark Pink Handles- Pink Tile bag and Pink Rack case

Navy Blue with Light Blue handles- Navy Blue tile bag and Navy Rack Case

Khaki with Turquoise handles- Grey Tile bag and Gray Rack case

 

Tote measures:  It is 21 1/4  inches wide, 13 1/2 tall  and the mat area (on both sides) is 10/14 inches.

description:
Cherry Blossom American Mah Jongg Tile Set

Delicate, elegant, and timeless, our Cherry Blossom Mah Jongg Tile Set celebrates the beauty of tradition with a fresh artistic touch. Each tile is engraved and hand painted, featuring Mah Jongg Maven’s signature colorful suits that honor the long-standing tradition of American Mah Jongg while adding vibrant style to your game.

Designed for both casual play and competitive tournaments, this set is tournament approved and crafted with the quality and attention to detail that Mah Jongg Maven is known for.

Be sure to view the photos to appreciate our beautifully detailed colorful suits, Dragons, and Jokers—every tile is a work of art.

Each Cherry Blossom Set Includes:

  • Dots
  • Cracks
  • Bams
  • Winds
  • Dragons
  • 12 Flowers
  • 8 Jokers
  • 10 Blank Tiles

We typically keep the 8 extra blank tiles so they’re available if you ever decide to customize your set in the future. If you would like the blank tiles shipped with your order, simply leave a note at checkout, and we’ll be happy to include them.

Bring the beauty of cherry blossoms to your Mah Jongg table with a set that’s as stunning as it is enjoyable to play.

name: Mah Jongg: The Art of the Game: A Collector’s Guide to Mah Jongg Tiles and Set. (Hardcover)
description:
“I thoroughly enjoyed this book. Whether used as a reference or a beautiful keepsake, it’s a very worthy addition to the world of Mah Jongg.” –Ruth Unger, President, National Mah Jongg League

**Great coffee table book and Gift***

This is the first book to fully capture the story of the exotic and exciting game of Mahjong or “Mah Jongg,” offering an intimate look at the history of the game as well as the visual beauty of the tiles. When authors Ann Israel and Gregg Swain began playing Mahjong, they were unaware of the vintage collections that existed not only in the United States but also across the globe. Slowly, they started to collect their own sets of Mahjong and as their collections grew, so did their appreciation of the history of, and interest in, the game.

Finding few references, Israel and Swain set out to create a book that chronicles the early beginnings of the game and documents Mahjong sets from the most basic, made of paper, to the most precious materials such as ivory and mother-of-pearl. Recognized and respected scholars and game experts have collaborated with Israel and Swain, contributing essential chapters on the game’s history and its pieces as well as technical information on the tiles. Lastly, prominent collectors from around the globe have shared their incredible sets and memories for the first time in one book for everyone to enjoy.

With hundreds of beautiful new images by renowned photographer Michel Arnaud, and including historical documentation and ephemera, Mah Jongg: The Art of the Game fills the void between the past’s and today’s game, providing vision, inspiration and resources. Anyone who has ever been intrigued by a Mahjong tile will find in these pages visually stunning photographs that will entice them into becoming an enthusiast of the timeless game of Mahjong.

name: Mah Jongg Mondays: a memoir about friendship, love, and faith
description:
Join Fern and a colorful cast of characters in her debut memoir titled Mah Jongg Mondays. Fern, married and the mother of three boys takes us into her modern middle-class suburban Long Island world where one day she gets the “Big Idea” to learn the Chinese tile game called mah jongg. Weekly games provide the setting for deep-seeded friendships to form around the mah jongg table. These Monday gatherings become a source of support and strength for Fern as her husband is diagnosed with cancer. Fear, insecurity and potential heart-wrenching loss become challenges she must overcome. The author weaves the themes of destiny, faith, friendship, time and love throughout the story. Fern takes us on her journey around the mah jongg table, eastward to the seaport town of Greenport and through her husband’s battle with cancer as she relies on faith, friendship and her personal relationship with God. Read this heartwarming story about the wonderful things that can happen when five women are destined to come together to play an old Chinese game, sitting around a table with 152 tiles, dice and a mah jongg card. Love always; love all ways, for time has no guarantees.

 

Perfect gift for any Mah Jongg player!!

name: American Mah Jongg for Everyone: The Complete Beginner’s Guide -Hardcover
description:
Whether you’re an American Mah Jongg newbie or an intermediate player looking to gain an edge over your opponents, American Mah Jongg for Everyone is the perfect book to help you start practicing your game!

Experienced international Mah Jongg instructors Gregg Swain and Toby Salk walk you through the basics of American Mah Jongg–introducing readers to the tiles, rituals, history, rules and winning strategies of the game. Using the humor, warmth and professional tips they share with their own students, this narrative-style instruction book offers an accessible way to learn this popular game.

Topics include:

  • Recognizing Mah Jongg tiles in different types of sets
  • Building the walls and dealing the tiles
  • Organizing your tiles and planning your play
  • Understanding table rules and etiquette
  • Winning strategies for various types of hands

National Mah Jongg tournament director Gladys Grad contributes a foreword that explains why so many people love the game. Grad also has written a chapter that outlines the rules of Siamese Mah Jongg, a fun two-person game she created that you can’t find in any other Mah Jongg book!

This book comes with everything you need to get started playing, including:

  • A timeless sample Mah Jongg scoring card
  • A paper set to cut out and use while learning
  • Easy-to-follow, step-by-step instructions
  • Over 80 color illustrations
  • Helpful practice exercises and quizzes that reinforce the lessons
  • Access to a website that provides up to date information about the game
  • A glossary of terms that every Mah Jongg player needs to know

From the many different types of tiles and how to recognize them, personal stories about the game and historical trivia, American Mah Jongg for Everyone has something for anyone interested in this fascinating game.

name: Mah Jongg Charleston Assist
short_description: Mah Jongg Charleston Assist- never lose place and know when to Blind pass or Stop the Charleston-great for new players!
description:
Take the guesswork out of which Pass of the Charleston you are on and always know exactly when it is an approriate option to Blind Pass or Stop the passing completely. The Mah Jongg Charleston Assist (MJCA) is made of durable, styrene plastic that will last for game after game. This  American Mah Jongg game device will help you step through the Charleston with ease! Simply designate a player who will turn the hand of the MJCA one segment for each Pass of the Charleston. Never get lost in the Charleston again!

The Mah Jongg Charleston Assist is made of durable styrene plastic which can be cleaned with a damp cloth and mild dish soap (harsh cleansers not recommended). Gently dry with clean cloth.

There’s lots to learn!

 

Mahjong is adored around the world. The Maven is right here to offer all kinds of mahjong items and gift ideas.

Appreciate playing mahjong alongside family and friends. Quiet the mind by playing mahjong.

Mahjong began in China and is typically played with 4 players.

Eventhough the game requires a bit of chance, it likewise requires skill, strategy and calculation.

The game employs 144 tiles having each player starting off with 13 tiles.

Simples tiles include dots, bamboo and characters.
Honors tiles consist of Winds and Dragons.
Flowers and Seasons are bonus tiles.

Here, at mahjongmaven.com, you can buy sets of tiles, custom tiles with your name on it, carrying cases, hands, and mahjong gifts.
